run_adversarial_attack: run an adversarial attack on a neural network model with parameter uncertainty sampling
create_params_sampling_fn: create a parameter sampling function that draws truncated normal or dropout samples per layer
build_forward_fn: build a forward function with parameter sampling and softmax-space averaging for logit computation
sample_truncated_normal: sample from a truncated normal distribution given mean, std, and interval bounds
sample_dropout: sample from a dropout distribution by applying a Bernoulli retention mask to 2D parameters
